confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant, cafe and drink anchors are moderately confident (roughly 20-30%); accommodation is least certain given peak-season and regional-security swings. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.3x and 1.1x). The FX value came from a search summary of the RBA overview page and was not verified in the RBA table; another search showed an older RBA page (20 March 2026), so treat the FX observation as provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparator city. Benchmarked to Israel's high local price level and to other high-cost Mediterranean coastal tourist cities, with food and drink set above Athens- and Lisbon-type levels and hotel anchors reflecting central Tel Aviv demand in July peak season.
